brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates comprehensive responsibility-chain fulfillment across all 7 RCs, with correct prioritization of BI-RADS 4B, proper peri-procedure safety guidance, and thorough red flag education. Multiple high-order points were completed with meaningful trajectory impact, including dynamic reprioritization when pathology became available and safe bounded closure. One doctor message contained only "..." (lite_evt_00415), which was a minor communication lapse but did not constitute a responsibility-chain error or harm. The trajectory ended with active pathology interpretation guidance when a runtime error terminated the conversation.

citations.explanation: Doctor provided structured guidance for patient to read pathology report line-by-line, explaining what each field means and confirming early-stage favorable prognosis
citations.quote: 您照着我说的顺序念，我们一句一句走完

closure_assessment.explanation: At trajectory end, doctor was actively guiding patient through pathology interpretation. Patient had received explanation of DCIS with focal microinvasion, understood it was early-stage with favorable markers (ER/PR+, HER2 1+, Ki-67 10%), and was given specific next steps for follow-up. The conversation was interrupted mid-guidance by runtime error, but patient had actionable plan: read specific pathology lines, understand each field, and seek appropriate follow-up.
